name: onboarding-start
description: Start Curia's own onboarding with the principal (Curia learning how they like to work) because they asked for it ("can we do the onboarding?"). Never for onboarding a new employee, hire, contractor or client. Creates the onboarding task and its first-conversation topics, holds inbox triage until they hear what to expect, and starts the research homework. Sends nothing: carry on the conversation yourself. Use only when the principal asks; onboarding never starts on its own. If onboarding was already completed this refuses; set `redo` only after the principal has explicitly confirmed they want to redo Curia's onboarding from the start.

inputs.redo: boolean? (true only after the principal explicitly confirmed redoing onboarding from the start; needed when it was already completed)

outputs.restartScheduled: boolean (true when Curia restarts in a moment to load what onboarding needs)
outputs.instruction: string? (when restarting: what to tell the principal first)
